contents: **Checked interfaces are self-contained semantic values.** Signature lowering reads CST from one stash and writes all checked types, binders, predicates, and retained alias applications into a separate result stash. No checked value points into tree-sitter state or the source CST stash. This is the signature-level ownership boundary established by [Stash for type-level interning](../../../rfds/architectural-foundations/README.md#stash-for-type-level-interning).
